findings.issue: Native partition deparse depended on observer timezone, and original initializer produced distinct bounds under UTC and America/New_York
findings.resolution: Canonical UTC observations with caller setting restored; exact independently captured initializer alternatives; require source bounds unchanged through migration

findings.issue: Global proof equality would force future releases to rewrite immutable historical profiles when adding a target initializer
findings.resolution: Every historical profile selects only rules present in its checksum-qualified proof; future proof may retain old rules alongside new exact rules without editing old profile artifacts

findings.issue: Publication needed actual installed migration evidence tied to its exact source
findings.resolution: Publish job requires passing, non-skipped Linux receipt with GITHUB_SHA, exact recipe and native manifest correspondence; archives complete original evidence before checksumming assets

findings.issue: Linux Nagle/delayed ACK in fault-only relay exhausted production migration deadline before COMMIT
findings.resolution: TCP_NODELAY on the fixture accepted socket; retain real COMMIT response loss and unchanged production budgets

findings.issue: Raw-native regression fixtures started fresh transactions without the new latest cohort declaration
findings.resolution: Adopt latest host sessions for native ceiling and second-reader controls; retain explicit unstamped refusal, original native guard results, distinct actor/validator identity and atomic no-write checks

findings.issue: Rollback observation claimed resource release just before closing the original connection
findings.resolution: Close the original rolled-back connection before recording confirmed resource release; live-backend barrier proves no premature claim and read-only reconciliation stays conservative

findings.issue: Preview race observer depended on an untruncated function name beyond pg_stat_activity default capture after new admission SQL
findings.resolution: A test-only driver-boundary comment marks only the real native preview command; actual snapshot/revocation expectations and production SQL semantics stay unchanged

findings.issue: Native relation inventory omitted inheritance parent links and partition-key definitions
findings.resolution: Capture exact cross-namespace table/index inheritance and partition keys; refreshed pre-publication profiles using unchanged real wheels and byte-identical native recipes. Corruption case starts from admitted source and changes only parent links, then refuses before effects.
